fields.v: Two-layer growth: Layer 1 invariants specified up front; Layer 2 features as hardest-first vertical slices. Per feature: 1 Select story/target node (Planner proposal); 2 run growth rules (6 rules) to update minimal specs; 3 assemble context deterministically (Spine: root invariants + spine contracts + node spec + dependency contracts + own code); 4 Implement (code + same-commit spec delta); 5 Validate (drift check Intent Graph vs Evidence Graph); 6 Gate (HARD/SOFT/AUTO); 7 Update spec graph (index regenerated)
